name: Short Cut Chicken Ramen with Mushrooms, Kimchi & Egg

ingredients.name: instant ramen noodle soup, chicken flavor

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat. Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and golden, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1 (227 g) pkg sliced white mushrooms
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, halve eggs lengthwise and set aside.
When the mushrooms are done, add hot water (from the tap) to the pot. Bring to a boil over high heat.

Once the water has come to a boil, add chicken and noodles (reserving spice packets) to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until chicken is warmed through and noodles are soft, 3-4 minutes. Remove soup from heat, add flavor packets, and stir until combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
227 g cooked chicken (shredded)
2 (85 g) pkg instant ramen noodle soup, chicken flavor

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide soup, eggs, and kimchi between bowls. Enjoy!
